card.fact_statement: Tameryraptor is known from rock layers of the Bahariya Formation.
card.source_span: It is known from a partial skeleton collected in rock layers from the Bahariya Formation by crews of German paleontologist Ernst Stromer in 1914

target_qa_variants.question: タメリラプトルはどの累層の岩石層から知られていますか？
target_qa_variants.source_span: It is known from a partial skeleton collected in rock layers from the Bahariya Formation by crews of German paleontologist Ernst Stromer in 1914
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'geological formation' as 累層 (ruisou) and 'Bahariya Formation' as バハリヤ累層.
